entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments:
Title.  The affliction which exhausts the psalmist's strength, and threatens to shorten his days, is not simply personal suffering from sickness, but suffering which he shares in common with Zion, and which is caused, in part at least, by the reproaches that he endures for her sake.  This explains why he connects his own restoration with the enlargement of God's people. 
 
Prayer is the unfailing resource of God's people in trouble, and by it they obtain from God the support and comfort which they need.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: My bones cleave to my skin; a description of extreme emaciation.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: Of the desert; or, dwelling in desolate places.

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments:
A sparrow; the Hebrew word is often used for the smaller birds generally. 
 
  Alone; sitting solitary, as when deprived of its mate or its young.

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments:
Lifted me up, and cast me down; lifted me up from the ground, that thou mightest dash me against it. 
 
Trials as well as mercies come from God, and when they truly mourn her low estate, the time of her deliverance is near.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: Like a shadow that declineth; that is stretched out at evening, a sign that it is soon to disappear in the darkness of night.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments:
Take pleasure in her stones; an affectionate interest in Zion, even in her desolations. 
 
Zion is dear to the friends of God, and when they truly mourn her low estate, the time of her deliverance is near.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments:
So; as the effect of God's having mercy upon Zion. 
 
The prosperity of the church glorifies God and brings salvation to men.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: It is God's design that his dealings with his people in one age, should be recorded for the admonition and encouragement of all coming generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: Those that are appointed to death; the prisoners whom their enemies had appointed to death.  These words have their highest fulfilment in the redemption which Christ brings to men from the spiritual bondage of sin and death eternal; and to him, as one with the Father, this psalm is applied in the New Testament.

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: God is moved with compassion in view of the sorrows which sin has brought upon the human race, and he will one day break the yoke of Satan and set the world free from his dominion.  Then His service shall be the joyful employment of all men.

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: Thou art the same; the unchangeable God.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The unchangeableness of God insures the fulfilment of all his promises, and will perpetuate the blessings of his people for ever.
